name: Angyi Island
notes: Gazetteer describes Angyi as the island later divided north/south into Twante and Kungyangon and explicitly includes Kawhmu circles.

name: Maubin Island
source: World Bank / historical Burma delta reclamation sources
notes: Historical and engineering sources explicitly refer to the entire Maubin Island.

name: Labutta Island
source: World Bank Paddyland II / delta reclamation sources
notes: World Bank sources explicitly name Labutta Island and distinguish its north/south polders from the whole island.

name: Gajaria
notes: Official local source describes Gajaria as a river-enclosed island-like landmass.

name: Kalapara
source: Bangladesh WARPO Inventory of Coastal and Estuarine Islands & Chars
notes: Government island/char inventory catalogs Kalapara as a coastal/estuarine island unit.

name: Cù Lao Hai Sông
notes: Kinh Môn local history uses Cù Lao Hai Sông (Two-Rivers Island) for the water-bounded Kinh Môn tract.

name: Diviseema
notes: Diviseema is the established Krishna delta island region containing Nagayalanka and neighboring mandals.

name: Char Meghna
notes: Char Meghna coordinate falls essentially on the unresolved Raipura polygon and local sources classify the surrounding physiography as char.

name: Wilhelmsburg
notes: Hamburg officially describes Wilhelmsburg as an Elbe island and Germany's largest river island.

name: Hingalganj
notes: Local and regional sources explicitly describe Hingalganj as a river-surrounded Sundarbans island.

name: Patharpratima Island
notes: Regional census-backed description states the entire island is called Patharpratima.

name: Mawlamyine Island
notes: Mawlamyinegyun literally means Mawlamyine Island; historical geography places the town on Mawlamyine Island.

name: Karimpur Char
source: Bangladesh World Bank WSS / local geography
notes: World Bank physiographic table classifies Karimpur as Char; local accounts describe this inhabited Narsingdi tract as a chor/island.

name: Thongwa Island
source: World Bank Paddyland II / delta reclamation sources
notes: World Bank maps and project documents explicitly identify Thongwa Island in the Maubin-Kyaiklat delta tract.

name: Nansan Island
notes: Official Zhanjiang geography gives Nansan Island about 123.4 km2, closely matching the 129.1 km2 USGS polygon.

name: Ugborodo
notes: Local reporting describes Ugborodo as a huge island ('Dry land in the Sea'); the USGS polygon covers the Ugborodo/Ogidigben tract.

name: Bandar Imam Khomeini
notes: World Bank port report explicitly places former Bandar Shahpur (now Bandar Imam Khomeini) on an island in the Khor Musa tidal flats.

name: Da'ao Island
notes: Local government describes Da'ao as a mid-river island; published area about 42 km2 matches USGS 42.57 km2.

name: Chaolian Island
notes: Jiangmen government identifies Chaolian as a Xi River island with area 12.68 km2, matching USGS 13.22 km2.

name: Nam Thái Bình
notes: Hydraulic planning defines Nam Thái Bình as the tract between the Red River, Trà Lý and the sea; area about 667 km2 vs USGS 628 km2.

name: Mathbaria
notes: Established local name for the Baleshwar-Bishkhali water-bounded tract centered on Mathbaria.

name: Betagi
notes: Established local geographic name centered on Betagi in the Bishkhali delta tract.

name: Jhalokathi
notes: Established local geographic name for the Jhalokathi-centered water-bounded tract.

name: Amtali
notes: Established local name for the coastal Amtali tract bounded by major tidal rivers and channels.

name: Hải Hậu–Giao Thủy
notes: Established interdistrict geographic/planning name for the coastal tract between the Ninh Cơ/Red River distributaries and sea.

name: Dumki
notes: Established local name for the water-bounded Dumki/Patuakhali tract containing the polygon center.

name: Minbya
notes: Established local geographic name for the Lay Myo delta tract centered on Minbya.

name: Bakerganj
notes: Established local name for the river-bounded Bakerganj tract.

name: Tiên Lãng
notes: Established local name for the Tiên Lãng tract between the Thái Bình and Văn Úc river systems.

name: Wakema
notes: Established local name for the Wakema delta tract containing Wakema Township communities.

name: Muladi
notes: Established local name used for this inhabited Muladi river-island tract.

name: Mehendiganj
notes: Established local name for the Mehendiganj island/delta tract.

name: Batiaghata
notes: Established local name for the Batiaghata river-bounded tract.

name: Mawlamyinegyun
notes: Established local name for the larger Mawlamyinegyun delta tract.

name: Dacope
notes: Established local name for the Dacope river-bounded tract.

name: Pauktaw
notes: Established local name for the Pauktaw island-rich delta tract represented by this polygon.

name: Phú Vang
notes: Established local name for the coastal-lagoon land tract in Phú Vang.

name: Gobindapur
source: Bangladesh WARPO Inventory of Coastal and Estuarine Islands & Chars
notes: Government inventory names Gobindapur at essentially the polygon center within the Mehendiganj island complex.

name: Shwelaung Island
notes: Regional government explicitly refers to Shwelaung island in Wakema Township.

name: Daunggyi Island
source: World Bank / JICA Ayeyarwady delta reclamation sources
notes: Engineering sources explicitly name Daunggyi Island in Bogale and its component polders.

name: Char Charkimara
source: Bangladesh WARPO Inventory of Coastal and Estuarine Islands & Chars
notes: Government inventory names Char Charkimara in the corresponding Bhola-Barisal river tract.

name: Labutta Township
notes: Established local geographic name for this separate water-bounded tract within Labutta Township; no invented directional island label.

name: Harirampur
notes: Established local name for the Padma/Jamuna river-bounded Harirampur tract.

name: Hizla Gurabdi
source: Bangladesh WARPO Inventory of Coastal and Estuarine Islands & Chars
notes: Government inventory explicitly names Hizla Gurabdi in this Hizla river-island area.

name: Bishnandi Char
notes: Bishnandi Char is the established local char name in the polygon's Araihazar/Bishnandi tract.

name: Daulatpur
notes: Established local name for the Daulatpur river-bounded tract in Manikganj.

name: Myebon
notes: Established local name for the Myebon coastal/delta tract represented by the polygon.

name: Shahjadpur
notes: Established local name for the Jamuna river-bounded Shahjadpur tract.

name: Babuganj
notes: Established local name for the Babuganj river-bounded tract.

name: Kuakata
notes: Established local name for the southwestern Kalapara coastal landmass centered nearest the Kuakata tract.

name: Nantha Island
notes: Local conservation and scientific sources explicitly identify Nantha Island in the Rathedaung/Sittwe coastal area.

name: Labutta District
notes: Established local geographic name centered essentially on the mapped Labutta District locality; no invented directional island label.

name: Sonar Char
notes: Sonar Char is the closest established named char in the Monpura/Bhola polygon and local char complex.

name: Ponnagyun
notes: Established local name for the Ponnagyun river-dissected tract represented by the polygon.
